# Legit Organic

Legit Organic is a Ghanaian food marketplace connecting customers and organisations with produce sourced from Ghanaian growers.

## Main sections

- Market: https://legitorganic.com/products
- Plan the week: https://legitorganic.com/subscriptions
- Recipes: https://legitorganic.com/recipes
- Legit Organic Times: https://legitorganic.com/blog
- Business food supply: https://legitorganic.com/b2b
- About Legit Organic: https://legitorganic.com/about
- Contact: https://legitorganic.com/contact

## Policies

- Privacy policy: https://legitorganic.com/privacy-policy
- Terms and conditions: https://legitorganic.com/terms-of-service

Product availability and prices can change. Use the current product page as the source of truth.
